title: Little Wolf and Mother Wolf
story_html:
Mother Wolf was a magnificent animal. She had all the traits of a terrific hunter. She was very strong and fast. She knew how to hide and how to seize animals. Mother Wolf was the forest's supreme creature. Her skills were evident to all the other animals.

Mother Wolf lived in a den beneath a tree with her cub, Little Wolf. One morning at dawn, Little Wolf and Mother Wolf were eating breakfast. Little Wolf looked sad. Mother Wolf said, "What is wrong, my cub?"

Little Wolf said, "I want to be big like you. You can run and leap better than anyone. You can howl so loudly. Being big is a necessity, and I am so small."

Mother Wolf said, "Don't be dissatisfied with your size. Being small can be very helpful sometimes."

Just then, rain and hail began to fall. The tree was hit by lightning. It fell on the wolves' den. Little Wolf was scared. The wolves knew that escaping the den was vital. Mother Wolf said, "Little Wolf, I cannot move the heavy pile of branches. But you can escape with ease. You can get out and find help!"

Little Wolf crawled out of the den and called all the large animals for help. They went to the den and pulled away the branches. Mother Wolf came out and said, "Thank you, Little Wolf! You saved my life!" She softly squeezed Little Wolf and kissed her.

Little Wolf smiled. She said, "Mother, this outcome has taught me a profound lesson. Even though I'm small, I'm still important."

questions.q: Why was Mother Wolf known as the forest's supreme creature?
opts: She was the biggest animal in the forest
She was strong, fast, and knew how to hide and seize animals
She lived in the tallest tree
All the animals were afraid of her howl

questions.q: Where did Mother Wolf live with Little Wolf?
opts: On top of a hill
In a cave near a river
In a nest in a tree
In a den beneath a tree

questions.q: Why did Little Wolf look sad at breakfast?
opts: She wanted to be big like her mother
She did not like her breakfast
She was scared of the storm
She had no friends in the forest

questions.q: In the story, the word "dissatisfied" is closest in meaning to:
opts: excited
surprised
not happy
very tired

questions.q: What happened to the wolves' den during the storm?
opts: It was washed away by the rain
It was filled with hail
Another animal took it
A tree hit by lightning fell on it

questions.q: Why couldn't Mother Wolf escape from the den?
opts: She could not move the heavy pile of branches
She was hurt by the lightning
She was too scared to move
The den was under water

questions.q: How did Little Wolf save her mother?
opts: She moved the branches by herself
She dug a new way out of the den
She crawled out and called all the large animals for help
She howled until the storm stopped

questions.q: What did Mother Wolf do when she came out of the den?
opts: She scolded Little Wolf for leaving
She thanked Little Wolf, squeezed her softly, and kissed her
She chased the large animals away
She started to rebuild the den

questions.q: The wolves knew that escaping the den was "vital." This means escaping was:
opts: extremely important
impossible
very easy
not necessary

questions.q: What profound lesson did Little Wolf learn from this outcome?
opts: Big animals are always the most helpful
Storms are dangerous for small animals
Even though she is small, she is still important
She should always listen to her mother
